content: MK reports that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn concludes by describing a hostile confrontation he began in Isfahan with a group he identifies only as 'the ringleaders of depravity and sedition', which MK says can only refer to the Hurufis and which he takes to be the only time Ṣāʾin al-Dīn refers to the movement with any specificity, his sense of outrage 'radiating from the page'.
